assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis is unspecified atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis code I48.91 is documented.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack.
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction.
The mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for arrhythmic burden.
The mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to optimize anticoagulation management.
The service was denied under reason code CO-22.
The claim is for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The denial reason code CO-22 indicates that coverage may be available through another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols.
The payer is Prairie State Medicaid.
The payer is the secondary payer.
